absolute_scale_contract.e2_scale: one independently learned absolute E8M0 scale per group, shared by E2M3 and E2M1
absolute_scale_contract.initialization: initial E4 exponent+6 once before optimizer, no RNG draw
absolute_scale_contract.after_initialization: never recompute phi from current source; no relative-factor constraint
absolute_scale_contract.codes: E4 source -> exponent MSB E2M3 -> mantissa E2M1 unchanged
absolute_scale_contract.gradient: same identity weight STE plus ln2 group-sum(grad*q) scale surrogate; no normalization

notes: No new accuracy results are bundled. Historical references are retained byte for byte.
The independent E2 scale no longer follows current E4 amax automatically; this is the intended parameterization change.
Finite E8M0 does not guarantee finite FP32 products; decode overflow fails explicitly.
